concept: One request, one board. A login form leaves a browser card and crosses a plain path to a server card, past a slate watcher box that copies whatever passes into its tray. The board never changes layout; each section adds one thing (a certificate, key slots, the key as a lens, a failed name row) and the watcher's tray shows what it learned: readable fields, two useless values, then only noise. A second station, an address bar to the right, carries the habit. The padlock that appears open on the promise closes in blue on the payoff, on the opening frame.
world: Plain light corporate field (pack mesh off, dot grid on): station 'board' (the HTTPS path board, fixed layout) and station 'bar' (a large generic address bar) to its right. No people, no sets, no presenter.
look: corporate-clean classic flat: white cards with offset shadow, navy ink, slate context, one blue for the named thing (Submit, then the shared key, then the closing padlock), teal ticks, one red cross in the check.

devices.what: The form packet: a small card with two readable rows that morphs into a row of slate scrambled blocks when it passes the key, and back at the far end. Same object every crossing.
The tray under the watcher box: the measure of exposure. Readable copy in s1, two copied values beside an empty key slot in s3, the same noise in s4 and the payoff.

The certificate card: domain row, key row, dates row and an authority seal; teal ticks stamp row by row, it shrinks to a ticked badge, re-lights on the recall, and its name row turns red in the check.

Swap slots: one at each end of the path and one by the watcher. Matching blue keys drop into the end slots only; the watcher's stays empty. The end keys then act as the lens the packet passes through.
One generic padlock: open above the path on the promise, carries the meaning labels at the address bar, closes in blue on the payoff.
Join device: continue joins on the held board with a camera push to the part the voice names and a pull back to wide; hard cuts only at the check, the habit station and the payoff return.

join_material: none beyond camera and continue on the held board (editorial family: no material wipes)

value_script.accent: the two blue keys at the ends only

value_script.why: The transformation: readable to noise and back.
